name: Burgos Cathedral
description: Burgos Cathedral rises over the old centre of Burgos in northern Spain. Work began in 1221 in the French Gothic style, then paused for almost 200 years before the lacy openwork spires and the star-vaulted Constable's Chapel were added in the 1400s and 1500s. Inside, carved choir stalls, tombs and stained glass reward a slow visit.
